brand.name: ServiceFlow
brand.tagline: Run Your Salon Like a Pro. Book More. Stress Less.
brand.description: All-in-one management system for salons, spas, clinics, and barbershops in the Philippines.
brand.market: Local beauty businesses — salons, barbershops, nail studios, spas, aesthetic clinics

app_colors.note: These are the actual app/brand colors — used in the dashboard UI and brand identity.

app_typography.note: Fonts used inside the actual app.
app_typography.display: Space Grotesk — geometric modern sans, used for headings
app_typography.body: IBM Plex Sans — clean neutral, used for UI copy
app_typography.mono: JetBrains Mono — code, IDs, reference numbers

social_post_visual_profile.note: This section defines the aesthetic for all social media content — inspired by luxury beauty editorial style (warm earthy tones, mixed typography, cinematic photography).
social_post_visual_profile.reference_brand: ESTHBeautyInc-style — luxury skincare editorial meets Filipino beauty industry

color_palette.description: Warm earthy tones. No cold colors. The entire palette lives in the caramel-to-cream-to-deep-brown spectrum.

warm_cream.usage: Light backgrounds, text panels, soft overlays

espresso.usage: Darkest tone — deep background for contrast posts

pure_white.usage: Text on dark/photo backgrounds, product labels

no_go_colors: #16a34a (keep emerald green for app UI only, not social posts)

text_colors.on_photo: #FFFFFF with optional very subtle text shadow

gradient_options: linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent, rgba(61,32,16,0.7)) — photo scrim overlay

typography_on_posts.description: The signature look is a MIXED typography system — large serif italic paired with bold sans-serif. This creates the luxury editorial tension.

sans_part.font: Cormorant Garamond Bold OR Playfair Display Bold (sans-serif feel at display size)

serif_italic_part.font: Cormorant Garamond Italic OR Playfair Display Italic
serif_italic_part.style: italic, slightly larger, creates visual rhythm

headline_combination.rule: Alternate between regular and italic within the same headline for luxury editorial rhythm

font_stack_for_ai.primary: Cormorant Garamond — high-contrast serif, feels expensive, editorial
font_stack_for_ai.alternative: Playfair Display — similar editorial luxury serif
font_stack_for_ai.body_small: Inter or DM Sans Light — clean, airy, used for bullet points and captions

sizing.hero_headline: Very large — takes up 40–60% of the frame width
sizing.body_bullets: Small, light weight — generous line height
sizing.brand_name: Tiny, all-caps or small-caps — top corner, subtle

decorative_elements.asterisk: * — used as a decorative separator/accent, placed near headlines
decorative_elements.arrow: → — used for website URL or 'follow for more' CTA at bottom
decorative_elements.thin_line: 1px horizontal line — used to separate headline from bullet list
decorative_elements.circle_outline: Thin circle/oval — used for radial diagram layouts
decorative_elements.note: All decorative elements are white and very minimal — never overwhelming

subject: Close-up skin macro — pores, texture, dewy glow
Face/eyes/lips partial shots — intimate, not full portrait
Hands holding product — natural, unposed
Amber/brown glass product bottles (serums, droppers)
White minimalist tubes and packaging
Flat lay on neutral warm surface
lighting: Skin should look dewy, glowing, healthy
Backlit or side-lit for skin glow effect
Never flash photography — always natural or warm studio
color_grading: Warm LUT — push oranges and yellows, desaturate greens/blues
Slightly faded highlights — not blown out white
Deep warm shadows — not pure black
Skin tones should read golden/caramel, not red or pink
Overall feel: like a warm afternoon in a luxury spa
composition: Subject fills most of frame — tight crops are preferred
Text overlay on dark or gradient areas of the photo
Leave breathing room on one side for text block
models: Diverse skin tones — Filipino beauty is the focus
Clean, glowing skin — no heavy makeup look
Natural, unposed feeling — not stock photo
Calm, confident expression — never smiling too hard
Clothing: beige, cream, white, light tan only — never loud colors

pattern_1_photo_text_overlay.description: Full bleed photo background with text in lower-left or upper-left corner
pattern_1_photo_text_overlay.overlay: Subtle dark gradient scrim where text sits
pattern_1_photo_text_overlay.best_for: Feature announcements, single product spotlight, mood posts

pattern_2_split_product_info.description: Photo takes 50-60% of frame, remaining space is warm solid color (caramel or cream) with text and bullet list
pattern_2_split_product_info.divider: None — colors blend or abut cleanly

pattern_3_full_editorial_headline.description: Large close-up photo fills entire frame, huge mixed-typography headline overlaid in center or left

pattern_4_solid_bg_with_product.description: Warm solid or gradient background (caramel/cream/espresso), product image floating with slight shadow

pattern_5_radial_diagram.description: Circular layout with subject in center, labels arranged radially around face/body
pattern_5_radial_diagram.line_style: Thin white lines connecting to labels
pattern_5_radial_diagram.best_for: Ingredient benefits, skincare routine order, layering guides

pattern_6_bullet_list_editorial.description: Large italic serif headline + numbered or bulleted list below, photo background
pattern_6_bullet_list_editorial.list_style: Small white text, light weight, with small icon or asterisk as bullet

branding_on_posts.logo_placement: Top-left corner — small, subtle, all-caps brand name
branding_on_posts.logo_style: Wordmark only — e.g. 'ServiceFlow.' or '@serviceflow_ph' in small caps
branding_on_posts.logo_color: White (on photo/dark bg) or espresso brown (on light bg)
branding_on_posts.website_url: Bottom of post — very small, light weight, with → arrow prefix
branding_on_posts.badge_element: Small pill badge in top corner — e.g. 'SALON MANAGEMENT · PH' in tiny caps

ai_image_generation_prompts.base_prompt: Luxury beauty editorial photography, warm earthy tones, caramel and cream color palette, close-up skin macro, golden warm lighting, Filipino model, dewy glowing skin, amber glass product bottles, minimalist composition, soft diffused light, warm LUT color grade, fashion editorial style, 4:5 portrait ratio
ai_image_generation_prompts.background_prompt: Warm gradient background, caramel to cream, soft bokeh, luxury spa aesthetic, no cold tones, earthy warm palette
ai_image_generation_prompts.product_prompt: Amber glass serum bottle, white minimalist packaging, floating on warm cream background, soft studio lighting, subtle shadow, clean luxury product photography
typography_prompt_notes: Use Cormorant Garamond or Playfair Display
Mix italic and regular weight in same headline
Large display size — headline should feel bold and editorial
Add single asterisk (*) as decorative accent near main headline

post_copy_guide.voice: Confident but warm. Speaks to Filipino salon owners directly. Short punchy sentences. Mix Tagalog flavor in casualness but write in English.
